units.rightText: Cursed be the man that maketh a graven or molten image, an abomination unto Jehovah, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and setteth it up in secret. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.

units.leftText: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or mother.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
units.rightText: Cursed be he that setteth light by his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

units.leftText: ‘Cursed is he who moves his neighbor’s boundary stone.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
units.rightText: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbor’s landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.

units.leftText: ‘Cursed is he who lets a blind man wander in the road.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
units.rightText: Cursed be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.

units.leftText: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
units.rightText: Cursed be he that wresteth the justice due to the sojourner, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.

units.leftText: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his father’s wife, for he has violated his father’s marriage bed.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
units.rightText: Cursed be he that lieth with his father’s wife, because he hath uncovered his father’s skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.
leftNotes: 27:20 Or uncovered his father’s skirt

units.leftText: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any animal.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
units.rightText: Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.

units.leftText: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
units.rightText: Cursed be he that lieth with his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

units.leftText: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his mother-in-law.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
units.rightText: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother-in-law. And all the people shall say, Amen.

units.leftText: ‘Cursed is he who strikes down his neighbor in secret.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
units.rightText: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbor in secret. And all the people shall say, Amen.

units.leftText: ‘Cursed is he who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
units.rightText: Cursed be he that taketh a bribe to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.

units.leftText: ‘Cursed is he who does not put the words of this law into practice.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’[’’]
units.rightText: Cursed be he that confirmeth not the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.
leftNotes: 27:26 LXX Cursed is every man who does not continue in all the words of this law; cited in Galatians 3:10|GAL 3:10*

units.leftText: “Now if you faithfully obey the voice of the LORD your God and are careful to follow all His commandments I am giving you today, the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of Jehovah thy God, to observe to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that Jehovah thy God will set thee on high above all the nations of the earth:

units.leftText: And all these blessings will come upon you and overtake you, if you will obey the voice of the LORD your God:
units.rightText: and all these blessings shall come upon thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of Jehovah thy God.

units.leftText: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.
units.rightText: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.

units.leftText: The fruit of your womb will be blessed, as well as the produce of your land and the offspring of your livestock — the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.
units.rightText: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy beasts, the increase of thy cattle, and the young of thy flock.

units.leftText: Your basket and kneading bowl will be blessed.
units.rightText: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy kneading-trough.

units.leftText: You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.
units.rightText: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out.

units.leftText: The LORD will cause the enemies who rise up against you to be defeated before you. They will march out against you in one direction but flee from you in seven.
units.rightText: Jehovah will cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thee: they shall come out against thee one way, and shall flee before thee seven ways.

units.leftText: The LORD will decree a blessing on your barns and on everything to which you put your hand; the LORD your God will bless you in the land He is giving you.
units.rightText: Jehovah will command the blessing upon thee in thy barns, and in all that thou puttest thy hand unto; and he will bless thee in the land which Jehovah thy God giveth thee.

units.leftText: The LORD will establish you as His holy people, just as He has sworn to you, if you keep the commandments of the LORD your God and walk in His ways.
units.rightText: Jehovah will establish thee for a holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee; if thou shalt keep the commandments of Jehovah thy God, and walk in his ways.

units.leftText: Then all the peoples of the earth will see that you are called by the name of the LORD, and they will stand in awe of you.
units.rightText: And all the peoples of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of Jehovah; and they shall be afraid of thee.

units.leftText: The LORD will make you prosper abundantly — in the fruit of your womb, the offspring of your livestock, and the produce of your land — in the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.
units.rightText: And Jehovah will make thee plenteous for good, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which Jehovah sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

units.leftText: The LORD will open the heavens, His abundant storehouse, to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands. You will lend to many nations, but borrow from none.
units.rightText: Jehovah will open unto thee his good treasure the heavens, to give the rain of thy land in its season, and to bless all the work of thy hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.

units.leftText: The LORD will make you the head and not the tail; you will only move upward and never downward, if you hear and carefully follow the commandments of the LORD your God, which I am giving you today.
units.rightText: And Jehovah will make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if thou shalt hearken unto the commandments of Jehovah thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them,

units.leftText: Do not turn aside to the right or to the left from any of the words I command you today, and do not go after other gods to serve them. The Curses of Disobedience (Leviticus 20:1–9|LEV 20:1-9*; Leviticus 26:14–39|LEV 26:14-39*)
units.rightText: and shalt not turn aside from any of the words which I command you this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

units.leftText: If, however, you do not obey the LORD your God by carefully following all His commandments and statutes I am giving you today, all these curses will come upon you and overtake you:
units.rightText: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of Jehovah thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day, that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee.

units.leftText: You will be cursed in the city and cursed in the country.
units.rightText: Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.

units.leftText: Your basket and kneading bowl will be cursed.
units.rightText: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy kneading-trough.

units.leftText: The fruit of your womb will be cursed, as well as the produce of your land, the calves of your herds, and the lambs of your flocks.
units.rightText: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, the increase of thy cattle, and the young of thy flock.

units.leftText: You will be cursed when you come in and cursed when you go out.
units.rightText: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out.

units.leftText: The LORD will send curses upon you, confusion and reproof in all to which you put your hand, until you are destroyed and quickly perish because of the wickedness you have committed in forsaking Him.
units.rightText: Jehovah will send upon thee cursing, discomfiture, and rebuke, in all that thou puttest thy hand unto to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the evil of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.
leftNotes: 28:20 Hebrew Me

units.leftText: The LORD will make the plague cling to you until He has exterminated you from the land that you are entering to possess.
units.rightText: Jehovah will make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest in to possess it.

units.leftText: The LORD will strike you with wasting disease, with fever and inflammation, with scorching heat and drought, and with blight and mildew; these will pursue you until you perish.
units.rightText: Jehovah will smite thee with consumption, and with fever, and with inflammation, and with fiery heat, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.
leftNotes: 28:22 Or sword

units.leftText: The sky over your head will be bronze, and the earth beneath you iron.
units.rightText: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.

units.leftText: The LORD will turn the rain of your land into dust and powder; it will descend on you from the sky until you are destroyed.
units.rightText: Jehovah will make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.

units.leftText: The LORD will cause you to be defeated before your enemies. You will march out against them in one direction but flee from them in seven. You will be an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
units.rightText: Jehovah will cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies; thou shalt go out one way against them, and shalt flee seven ways before them: and thou shalt be tossed to and from among all the kingdoms of the earth.

units.leftText: Your corpses will be food for all the birds of the air and beasts of the earth, with no one to scare them away.
units.rightText: And thy dead body shall be food unto all birds of the heavens, and unto the beasts of the earth; and there shall be none to frighten them away.

units.leftText: The LORD will afflict you with the boils of Egypt, with tumors and scabs and itch from which you cannot be cured.
units.rightText: Jehovah will smite thee with the boil of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scurvy, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.

units.leftText: The LORD will afflict you with madness, blindness, and confusion of mind,
units.rightText: Jehovah will smite thee with madness, and with blindness, and with astonishment of heart;

units.leftText: and at noon you will grope about like a blind man in the darkness. You will not prosper in your ways. Day after day you will be oppressed and plundered, with no one to save you.
units.rightText: and thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and robbed alway, and there shall be none to save thee.

units.leftText: You will be pledged in marriage to a woman, but another man will violate her. You will build a house but will not live in it. You will plant a vineyard but will not enjoy its fruit.
units.rightText: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build a house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not use the fruit thereof.

units.leftText: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes, but you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be taken away and not returned to you. Your flock will be given to your enemies, and no one will save you.
units.rightText: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to save thee.

units.leftText: Your sons and daughters will be given to another nation, while your eyes grow weary looking for them day after day, with no power in your hand.
units.rightText: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people; and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day: and there shall be nought in the power of thy hand.

units.leftText: A people you do not know will eat the produce of your land and of all your toil. All your days you will be oppressed and crushed.
units.rightText: The fruit of thy ground, and all thy labors, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway;

units.leftText: You will be driven mad by the sights you see.
units.rightText: so that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

units.leftText: The LORD will afflict you with painful, incurable boils on your knees and thighs, from the soles of your feet to the top of your head.
units.rightText: Jehovah will smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore boil, whereof thou canst not be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the crown of thy head.

units.leftText: The LORD will bring you and the king you appoint to a nation neither you nor your fathers have known, and there you will worship other gods— gods of wood and stone.
units.rightText: Jehovah will bring thee, and thy king whom thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation that thou hast not known, thou nor thy fathers; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.

units.leftText: You will become an object of horror, scorn, and ridicule among all the nations to which the LORD will drive you.
units.rightText: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all the peoples whither Jehovah shall lead thee away.

units.leftText: You will sow much seed in the field but harvest little, because the locusts will consume it.
units.rightText: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather little in; for the locust shall consume it.

units.leftText: You will plant and cultivate vineyards, but will neither drink the wine nor gather the grapes, because worms will eat them.
units.rightText: Thou shalt plant vineyards and dress them, but thou shalt neither drink of the wine, nor gather the grapes; for the worm shall eat them.

units.leftText: You will have olive trees throughout your territory but will never anoint yourself with oil, because the olives will drop off.
units.rightText: Thou shalt have olive-trees throughout all thy borders, but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil; for thine olive shall cast its fruit.

units.leftText: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not remain yours, because they will go into captivity.
units.rightText: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but they shall not be thine; for they shall go into captivity.

units.leftText: Swarms of locusts will consume all your trees and the produce of your land.
units.rightText: All thy trees and the fruit of thy ground shall the locust possess.

units.leftText: The foreigner living among you will rise higher and higher above you, while you sink down lower and lower.
units.rightText: The sojourner that is in the midst of thee shall mount up above thee higher and higher; and thou shalt come down lower and lower.

units.leftText: He will lend to you, but you will not lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.
units.rightText: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.

units.leftText: All these curses will come upon you. They will pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, since you did not obey the LORD your God and keep the commandments and statutes He gave you.
units.rightText: And all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of Jehovah thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:

units.leftText: These curses will be a sign and a wonder upon you and your descendants forever.
units.rightText: and they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.

units.leftText: Because you did not serve the LORD your God with joy and gladness of heart in all your abundance,
units.rightText: Because thou servedst not Jehovah thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;

units.leftText: you will serve your enemies the LORD will send against you in famine, thirst, nakedness, and destitution. He will place an iron yoke on your neck until He has destroyed you.
units.rightText: therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies that Jehovah shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.

units.leftText: The LORD will bring a nation from afar, from the ends of the earth, to swoop down upon you like an eagle — a nation whose language you will not understand,
units.rightText: Jehovah will bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;

units.leftText: a ruthless nation with no respect for the old and no pity for the young.
units.rightText: a nation of fierce countenance, that shall not regard the person of the old, nor show favor to the young,

units.leftText: They will eat the offspring of your livestock and the produce of your land until you are destroyed. They will leave you no grain or new wine or oil, no calves of your herds or lambs of your flocks, until they have caused you to perish.
units.rightText: and shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy ground, until thou be destroyed; that also shall not leave thee grain, new wine, or oil, the increase of thy cattle, or the young of thy flock, until they have caused thee to perish.

units.leftText: They will besiege all the cities throughout your land, until the high and fortified walls in which you trust have fallen. They will besiege all your cities throughout the land that the LORD your God has given you.
units.rightText: And they shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fortified walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land; and they shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which Jehovah thy God hath given thee.

units.leftText: Then you will eat the fruit of your womb, the flesh of the sons and daughters whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you.
units.rightText: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, whom Jehovah thy God hath given thee, in the siege and in the distress wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee.

units.leftText: The most gentle and refined man among you will begrudge his brother, the wife he embraces, and the rest of his children who have survived,
units.rightText: The man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children whom he hath remaining;
leftNotes: 28:54 Hebrew the wife of his bosom

units.leftText: refusing to share with any of them the flesh of his children he will eat because he has nothing left in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you within all your gates.
units.rightText: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat, because he hath nothing left him, in the siege and in the distress wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in all thy gates.
leftNotes: 28:55 Or within all your cities; similarly in verse 57

units.leftText: The most gentle and refined woman among you, so gentle and refined she would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground, will begrudge the husband she embraces and her son and daughter
units.rightText: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,
leftNotes: 28:56 Hebrew the husband of her bosom

units.leftText: the afterbirth that comes from between her legs and the children she bears, because she will secretly eat them for lack of anything else in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you within your gates.
units.rightText: and toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she shall bear; for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly, in the siege and in the distress wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.

units.leftText: If you are not careful to observe all the words of this law which are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and awesome name— the LORD your God—
units.rightText: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, JEHOVAH THY GOD;

units.leftText: He will bring upon you and your descendants extraordinary disasters, severe and lasting plagues, and terrible and chronic sicknesses.
units.rightText: then Jehovah will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, even great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.

units.leftText: He will afflict you again with all the diseases you dreaded in Egypt, and they will cling to you.
units.rightText: And he will bring upon thee again all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.

units.leftText: The LORD will also bring upon you every sickness and plague not recorded in this Book of the Law, until you are destroyed.
units.rightText: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will Jehovah bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.

units.leftText: You who were as numerous as the stars in the sky will be left few in number, because you would not obey the voice of the LORD your God.
units.rightText: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou didst not hearken unto the voice of Jehovah thy God.

units.leftText: Just as it pleased the LORD to make you prosper and multiply, so also it will please Him to annihilate you and destroy you. And you will be uprooted from the land you are entering to possess.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, that, as Jehovah rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so Jehovah will rejoice over you to cause you to perish, and to destroy you; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest in to possess it.

units.leftText: Then the LORD will scatter you among all the nations, from one end of the earth to the other, and there you will worship other gods, gods of wood and stone, which neither you nor your fathers have known.
units.rightText: And Jehovah will scatter thee among all peoples, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou nor thy fathers, even wood and stone.

units.leftText: Among those nations you will find no repose, not even a resting place for the sole of your foot. There the LORD will give you a trembling heart, failing eyes, and a despairing soul.
units.rightText: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, and there shall be no rest for the sole of thy foot: but Jehovah will give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and pining of soul;

units.leftText: So your life will hang in doubt before you, and you will be afraid night and day, never certain of survival.
units.rightText: and thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear night and day, and shalt have no assurance of thy life.

units.leftText: In the morning you will say, ‘If only it were evening!’ and in the evening you will say, ‘If only it were morning!’— because of the dread in your hearts of the terrifying sights you will see.
units.rightText: In the morning thou shalt say, Would it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would it were morning! for the fear of thy heart which thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

units.leftText: The LORD will return you to Egypt in ships by a route that I said you should never see again. There you will sell yourselves to your enemies as male and female slaves, but no one will buy you.”
units.rightText: And Jehovah will bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I said unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall sell yourselves unto your enemies for bondmen and for bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.

units.leftText: These are the words of the covenant that the LORD commanded Moses to make with the Israelites in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant He had made with them at Horeb.
units.rightText: These are the words of the covenant which Jehovah commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, besides the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
leftNotes: 29:1 That is, Mount Sinai, or possibly a mountain in the range containing Mount Sinai

units.leftText: Moses summoned all Israel and proclaimed to them, “You have seen with your own eyes everything the LORD did in Egypt to Pharaoh, to all his officials, and to all his land.
units.rightText: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that Jehovah did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;

units.leftText: You saw with your own eyes the great trials, and those miraculous signs and wonders.
units.rightText: the great trials which thine eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders:

units.leftText: Yet to this day the LORD has not given you a mind to understand, eyes to see, or ears to hear.
units.rightText: but Jehovah hath not given you a heart to know, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.

units.leftText: For forty years I led you in the wilderness, yet your clothes and sandals did not wear out.
units.rightText: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxed old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxed old upon thy foot.

units.leftText: You ate no bread and drank no wine or strong drink, so that you might know that I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink; that ye may know that I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: When you reached this place, Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out against us in battle, but we defeated them.
units.rightText: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:

units.leftText: We took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
units.rightText: and we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.

units.leftText: So keep and follow the words of this covenant, that you may prosper in all you do.
units.rightText: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.

units.leftText: All of you are standing today before the LORD your God— you leaders of tribes, elders, officials, and all the men of Israel,
units.rightText: Ye stand this day all of you before Jehovah your God; your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,
leftNotes: 29:10 LXX and Syriac; Hebrew you leaders, tribes

units.leftText: your children and wives, and the foreigners in your camps who cut your wood and draw your water—
units.rightText: your little ones, your wives, and thy sojourner that is in the midst of thy camps, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water;

units.leftText: so that you may enter into the covenant of the LORD your God, which He is making with you today, and into His oath,
units.rightText: that thou mayest enter into the covenant of Jehovah thy God, and into his oath, which Jehovah thy God maketh with thee this day;

units.leftText: and so that He may establish you today as His people, and He may be your God as He promised you and as He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
units.rightText: that he may establish thee this day unto himself for a people, and that he may be unto thee a God, as he spake unto thee, and as he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

units.leftText: I am making this covenant and this oath not only with you,
units.rightText: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath,

units.leftText: but also with those who are standing here with us today in the presence of the LORD our God, as well as with those who are not here today.
units.rightText: but with him that standeth here with us this day before Jehovah our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day

units.leftText: For you yourselves know how we lived in the land of Egypt and how we passed through the nations on the way here.
units.rightText: (for ye know how we dwelt in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the midst of the nations through which ye passed;

units.leftText: You saw the abominations and idols among them made of wood and stone, of silver and gold.
units.rightText: and ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them);

units.leftText: Make sure there is no man or woman, clan or tribe among you today whose heart turns away from the LORD our God to go and worship the gods of those nations. Make sure there is no root among you that bears such poisonous and bitter fruit,
units.rightText: lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from Jehovah our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;
leftNotes: 29:18 See Hebrews 12:15|HEB 12:15*

units.leftText: because when such a person hears the words of this oath, he invokes a blessing on himself, saying, ‘I will have peace, even though I walk in the stubbornness of my own heart.’
units.rightText: and it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart, to destroy the moist with the dry.
leftNotes: 29:19 Or curse

units.leftText: The LORD will never be willing to forgive him. Instead, His anger and jealousy will burn against that man, and every curse written in this book will fall upon him. The LORD will blot out his name from under heaven
units.rightText: Jehovah will not pardon him, but then the anger of Jehovah and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse that is written in this book shall lie upon him, and Jehovah will blot out his name from under heaven.

units.leftText: and single him out from all the tribes of Israel for disaster, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this Book of the Law.
units.rightText: And Jehovah will set him apart unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that is written in this book of the law.

units.leftText: Then the generation to come — your sons who follow you and the foreigner who comes from a distant land — will see the plagues of the land and the sicknesses the LORD has inflicted on it.
units.rightText: And the generation to come, your children that shall rise up after you, and the foreigner that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses wherewith Jehovah hath made it sick;

units.leftText: All its soil will be a burning waste of sulfur and salt, unsown and unproductive, with no plant growing on it, just like the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which the LORD overthrew in His fierce anger.
units.rightText: and that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and a burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which Jehovah overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:

units.leftText: So all the nations will ask, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land? Why this great outburst of anger?’
units.rightText: even all the nations shall say, Wherefore hath Jehovah done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?

units.leftText: And the people will answer, ‘It is because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, which He made with them when He brought them out of the land of Egypt.
units.rightText: Then men shall say, Because they forsook the covenant of Jehovah, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt,

units.leftText: They went and served other gods, and they worshiped gods they had not known— gods that the LORD had not given to them.
units.rightText: and went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods that they knew not, and that he had not given unto them:

units.leftText: Therefore the anger of the LORD burned against this land, and He brought upon it every curse written in this book.
units.rightText: therefore the anger of Jehovah was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curse that is written in this book;

units.leftText: The LORD uprooted them from their land in His anger, rage, and great wrath, and He cast them into another land, where they are today.’
units.rightText: and Jehovah rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as at this day.

units.leftText: The secret things belong to the LORD our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our children forever, so that we may follow all the words of this law.[’’]
units.rightText: The secret things belong unto Jehovah our God; but the things that are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.

units.leftText: “When all these things come upon you— the blessings and curses I have set before you— and you call them to mind in all the nations to which the LORD your God has banished you,
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither Jehovah thy God hath driven thee,

units.leftText: and when you and your children return to the LORD your God and obey His voice with all your heart and all your soul according to everything I am giving you today,
units.rightText: and shalt return unto Jehovah thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thy heart, and with all thy soul;

units.leftText: then He will restore you from captivity and have compassion on you and gather you from all the nations to which the LORD your God has scattered you.
units.rightText: that then Jehovah thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the peoples, whither Jehovah thy God hath scattered thee.
leftNotes: 30:3 Or restore your fortunes

units.leftText: Even if you have been banished to the farthest horizon, He will gather you and return you from there.
units.rightText: If any of thine outcasts be in the uttermost parts of heaven, from thence will Jehovah thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:
leftNotes: 30:4 Or to the extremity of the heavens
30:4 Cited in Nehemiah 1:8–9|NEH 1:8-9*

units.leftText: And the LORD your God will bring you into the land your fathers possessed, and you will take possession of it. He will cause you to prosper and multiply more than your fathers.
units.rightText: and Jehovah thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.

units.leftText: The LORD your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, and you will love Him with all your heart and with all your soul, so that you may live.
units.rightText: And Jehovah thy God will circumcise thy heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love Jehovah thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.

units.leftText: Then the LORD your God will put all these curses upon your enemies who hate you and persecute you.
units.rightText: And Jehovah thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, that persecuted thee.

units.leftText: And you will again obey the voice of the LORD and follow all His commandments I am giving you today.
units.rightText: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of Jehovah, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.

units.leftText: So the LORD your God will make you abound in all the work of your hands and in the fruit of your womb, the offspring of your livestock, and the produce of your land. Indeed, the LORD will again delight in your prosperity, as He delighted in that of your fathers,
units.rightText: And Jehovah thy God will make thee plenteous in all the work of thy hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, for good: for Jehovah will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers;

units.leftText: if you obey the LORD your God by keeping His commandments and statutes that are written in this Book of the Law, and if you turn to Him with all your heart and with all your soul. The Choice of Life or Death
units.rightText: if thou shalt obey the voice of Jehovah thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law; if thou turn unto Jehovah thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul.

units.leftText: For this commandment I give you today is not too difficult for you or beyond your reach.
units.rightText: For this commandment which I command thee this day, it is not too hard for thee, neither is it far off.

units.leftText: It is not in heaven, that you should need to ask, ‘Who will ascend into heaven to get it for us and proclaim it, that we may obey it?’
units.rightText: It is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, and make us to hear it, that we may do it?
leftNotes: 30:12 Cited in Romans 10:6|ROM 10:6*

units.leftText: And it is not beyond the sea, that you should need to ask, ‘Who will cross the sea to get it for us and proclaim it, that we may obey it?’
units.rightText: Neither is it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, and make us to hear it, that we may do it?
leftNotes: 30:13 See Romans 10:7|ROM 10:7*.

units.leftText: But the word is very near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart, so that you may obey it.
units.rightText: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
leftNotes: 30:14 Cited in Romans 10:8|ROM 10:8*

units.leftText: See, I have set before you today life and prosperity, as well as death and disaster.
units.rightText: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;

units.leftText: For I am commanding you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in His ways, and to keep His commandments, statutes, and ordinances, so that you may live and increase, and the LORD your God may bless you in the land that you are entering to possess.
units.rightText: in that I command thee this day to love Jehovah thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his ordinances, that thou mayest live and multiply, and that Jehovah thy God may bless thee in the land whither thou goest in to possess it.

units.leftText: But if your heart turns away and you do not listen, but are drawn away to bow down to other gods and worship them,
units.rightText: But if thy heart turn away, and thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;

units.leftText: I declare to you today that you will surely perish; you shall not prolong your days in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.
units.rightText: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish; ye shall not prolong your days in the land, whither thou passest over the Jordan to go in to possess it.

units.leftText: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you today that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing. Therefore choose life, so that you and your descendants may live,
units.rightText: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that I have set before thee life and death, the blessing and the curse: therefore choose life, that thou mayest live, thou and thy seed;

units.leftText: and that you may love the LORD your God, obey Him, and hold fast to Him. For He is your life, and He will prolong your life in the land that the LORD swore to give to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.”
units.rightText: to love Jehovah thy God, to obey his voice, and to cleave unto him; for he is thy life, and the length of thy days; that thou mayest dwell in the land which Jehovah sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

units.leftText: When Moses had finished speaking these words to all Israel,
units.rightText: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.
leftNotes: 31:1 DSS and LXX; MT When Moses went out and spoke

units.leftText: he said to them, “I am now a hundred and twenty years old; I am no longer able to come and go, and the LORD has said to me, ‘You shall not cross the Jordan.’
units.rightText: And he said unto them, I am a hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: and Jehovah hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

units.leftText: The LORD your God Himself will cross over ahead of you. He will destroy these nations before you, and you will dispossess them. Joshua will cross ahead of you, as the LORD has said.
units.rightText: Jehovah thy God, he will go over before thee; he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt dispossess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as Jehovah hath spoken.

units.leftText: And the LORD will do to them as He did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, when He destroyed them along with their land.
units.rightText: And Jehovah will do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and unto their land; whom he destroyed.

units.leftText: The LORD will deliver them over to you, and you must do to them exactly as I have commanded you.
units.rightText: And Jehovah will deliver them up before you, and ye shall do unto them according unto all the commandment which I have commanded you.

units.leftText: Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid or terrified of them, for it is the LORD your God who goes with you; He will never leave you nor forsake you.”
units.rightText: Be strong and of good courage, fear not, nor be affrighted at them: for Jehovah thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
leftNotes: 31:6 Cited in Hebrews 13:5|HEB 13:5*; here and in verse 8

units.leftText: Then Moses called for Joshua and said to him in the presence of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you will go with this people into the land that the LORD swore to their fathers to give them, and you shall give it to them as an inheritance.
units.rightText: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of good courage: for thou shalt go with this people into the land which Jehovah hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.

units.leftText: The LORD Himself goes before you; He will be with you. He will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid or discouraged.” The Reading of the Law (Nehemiah 8:1–8|NEH 8:1-8*)
units.rightText: And Jehovah, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.

units.leftText: So Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and to all the elders of Israel.
units.rightText: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, that bare the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and unto all the elders of Israel.

units.leftText: Then Moses commanded them, “At the end of every seven years, at the appointed time in the year of remission of debt, during the Feast of Tabernacles,
units.rightText: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of every seven years, in the set time of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,
leftNotes: 31:10 That is, Sukkot, the autumn feast of pilgrimage to Jerusalem; also translated as the Feast of Booths or the Feast of Shelters and originally called the Feast of Ingathering(see Exodus 23:16|EXO 23:16* and Exodus 34:22).

units.leftText: when all Israel comes before the LORD your God at the place He will choose, you are to read this law in the hearing of all Israel.
units.rightText: when all Israel is come to appear before Jehovah thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

units.leftText: Assemble the people— men, women, children, and the foreigners within your gates— so that they may listen and learn to fear the LORD your God and to follow carefully all the words of this law.
units.rightText: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones, and thy sojourner that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear Jehovah your God, and observe to do all the words of this law;

units.leftText: Then their children who do not know the law will listen and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as you live in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.” God Commissions Joshua
units.rightText: and that their children, who have not known, may hear, and learn to fear Jehovah your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over the Jordan to possess it.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, the time of your death is near. Call Joshua and present yourselves at the Tent of Meeting, so that I may commission him.”
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tent of meeting, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: Then the LORD appeared at the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the cloud stood over the entrance to the tent.
units.rightText: And Jehovah appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud: and the pillar of cloud stood over the door of the Tent.

units.leftText: And the LORD said to Moses, “You will soon rest with your fathers, and these people will rise up and prostitute themselves with the foreign gods of the land they are entering. They will forsake Me and break the covenant I have made with them.
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and play the harlot after the strange gods of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.

units.leftText: On that day My anger will burn against them, and I will abandon them and hide My face from them, so that they will be consumed, and many troubles and afflictions will befall them. On that day they will say, ‘Have not these disasters come upon us because our God is no longer with us?’
units.rightText: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall come upon them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us because our God is not among us?

units.leftText: And on that day I will surely hide My face because of all the evil they have done by turning to other gods.
units.rightText: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evil which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.

units.leftText: Now therefore, write down for yourselves this song and teach it to the Israelites; have them recite it, so that it may be a witness for Me against them.
units.rightText: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach thou it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

units.leftText: When I have brought them into the land that I swore to give their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey, they will eat their fill and prosper. Then they will turn to other gods and worship them, and they will reject Me and break My covenant.
units.rightText: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxed fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.

units.leftText: And when many troubles and afflictions have come upon them, this song will testify against them, because it will not be forgotten from the lips of their descendants. For I know their inclination, even before I bring them into the land that I swore to give them.”
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are come upon them, that this song shall testify before them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they frame this day, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.

units.leftText: So that very day Moses wrote down this song and taught it to the Israelites.
units.rightText: So Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.

units.leftText: Then the LORD commissioned Joshua son of Nun and said, “Be strong and courageous, for you will bring the Israelites into the land that I swore to give them, and I will be with you.” The Law Placed in the Ark
units.rightText: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of good courage; for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.

units.leftText: When Moses had finished writing in a book the words of this law from beginning to end,
units.rightText: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

units.leftText: he gave this command to the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD:
units.rightText: that Moses commanded the Levites, that bare the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, saying,

units.leftText: “Take this Book of the Law and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, so that it may remain there as a witness against you.
units.rightText: Take this book of the law, and put it by the side of the ark of the covenant of Jehovah your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.

units.leftText: For I know how rebellious and stiff-necked you are. If you are already rebelling against the LORD while I am still alive, how much more will you rebel after my death!
units.rightText: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against Jehovah; and how much more after my death?

units.leftText: Assemble before me all the elders of your tribes and all your officers so that I may speak these words in their hearing and call heaven and earth to witness against them.
units.rightText: Assemble unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to witness against them.

units.leftText: For I know that after my death you will become utterly corrupt and turn from the path I have commanded you. And in the days to come, disaster will befall you because you will do evil in the sight of the LORD to provoke Him to anger by the work of your hands.” Moses Begins His Song
units.rightText: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do that which is evil in the sight of Jehovah, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.

units.leftText: Then Moses recited aloud to the whole assembly of Israel the words of this song from beginning to end:
units.rightText: And Moses spake in the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were finished.

units.leftText: Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak; hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
units.rightText: Give ear, ye heavens, and I will speak; And let the earth hear the words of my mouth.

units.leftText: Let my teaching fall like rain and my speech settle like dew, like gentle rain on new grass, like showers on tender plants.
units.rightText: My doctrine shall drop as the rain; My speech shall distil as the dew, As the small rain upon the tender grass, And as the showers upon the herb.

units.leftText: For I will proclaim the name of the LORD. Ascribe greatness to our God!
units.rightText: For I will proclaim the name of Jehovah: Ascribe ye greatness unto our God.

units.leftText: He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just. A God of faithfulness without injustice, righteous and upright is He.
units.rightText: The Rock, his work is perfect; For all his ways are justice: A God of faithfulness and without iniquity, Just and right is he.

units.leftText: His people have acted corruptly toward Him; the blemish on them is not that of His children, but of a perverse and crooked generation.
units.rightText: They have dealt corruptly with him, they are not his children, it is their blemish; They are a perverse and crooked generation.
leftNotes: 32:5 Cited in Philippians 2:15|PHP 2:15*

units.leftText: Is this how you repay the LORD, O foolish and senseless people? Is He not your Father and Creator? Has He not made you and established you?
units.rightText: Do ye thus requite Jehovah, O foolish people and unwise? Is not he thy father that hath bought thee? He hath made thee, and established thee.

units.leftText: Remember the days of old; consider the years long past. Ask your father, and he will tell you, your elders, and they will inform you.
units.rightText: Remember the days of old, Consider the years of many generations: Ask thy father, and he will show thee; Thine elders, and they will tell thee.

units.leftText: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when He divided the sons of man, He set the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the sons of God.
units.rightText: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, When he separated the children of men, He set the bounds of the peoples According to the number of the children of Israel.
leftNotes: 32:8 DSS; LXX according to the number of the angels of God; MT according to the number of the sons of Israel

units.leftText: But the LORD’s portion is His people, Jacob His allotted inheritance.
units.rightText: For Jehovah’s portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

units.leftText: He found him in a desert land, in a barren, howling wilderness; He surrounded him, He instructed him, He guarded him as the apple of His eye.
units.rightText: He found him in a desert land, And in the waste howling wilderness; He compassed him about, he cared for him, He kept him as the apple of his eye.
leftNotes: 32:10 Literally the pupil

units.leftText: As an eagle stirs up its nest and hovers over its young, He spread His wings to catch them and carried them on His pinions.
units.rightText: As an eagle that stirreth up her nest, That fluttereth over her young, He spread abroad his wings, he took them, He bare them on his pinions.
leftNotes: 32:11 Pinions are the outer parts of a bird’s wings, including the flight feathers.

units.leftText: The LORD alone led him, and no foreign god was with him.
units.rightText: Jehovah alone did lead him, And there was no foreign god with him.

units.leftText: He made him ride on the heights of the land and fed him the produce of the field. He nourished him with honey from the rock and oil from the flinty crag,
units.rightText: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, And he did eat the increase of the field; And he made him to suck honey out of the rock, And oil out of the flinty rock;

units.leftText: with curds from the herd and milk from the flock, with the fat of lambs, with rams from Bashan, and goats, with the choicest grains of wheat. From the juice of the finest grapes you drank the wine.
units.rightText: Butter of the herd, and milk of the flock, With fat of lambs, And rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, With the finest of the wheat; And of the blood of the grape thou drankest wine.

units.leftText: But Jeshurun grew fat and kicked— becoming fat, bloated, and gorged. He abandoned the God who made him and scorned the Rock of his salvation.
units.rightText: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: Thou art waxed fat, thou art grown thick, thou art become sleek; Then he forsook God who made him, And lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
leftNotes: 32:15 Jeshurun means the upright one, a term of endearment for Israel.

units.leftText: They provoked His jealousy with foreign gods; they enraged Him with abominations.
units.rightText: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods; With abominations provoked they him to anger.

units.leftText: They sacrificed to demons, not to God, to gods they had not known, to newly arrived gods, which your fathers did not fear.
units.rightText: They sacrificed unto demons, which were no God, To gods that they knew not, To new gods that came up of late, Which your fathers dreaded not.

units.leftText: You ignored the Rock who brought you forth; you forgot the God who gave you birth.
units.rightText: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, And hast forgotten God that gave thee birth.

units.leftText: When the LORD saw this, He rejected them, provoked to anger by His sons and daughters.
units.rightText: And Jehovah saw it, and abhorred them, Because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.

units.leftText: He said: “I will hide My face from them; I will see what will be their end. For they are a perverse generation— children of unfaithfulness.
units.rightText: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: For they are a very perverse generation, Children in whom is no faithfulness.

units.leftText: They have provoked My jealousy by that which is not God; they have enraged Me with their worthless idols. So I will make them jealous by those who are not a people; I will make them angry by a nation without understanding.
units.rightText: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; They have provoked me to anger with their vanities: And I will move them to jealousy with those that are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
leftNotes: 32:21 Or not a nation; see also LXX.
32:21 Cited in Romans 10:19|ROM 10:19*

units.leftText: For a fire has been kindled by My anger, and it burns to the depths of Sheol; it consumes the earth and its produce, and scorches the foundations of the mountains.
units.rightText: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, And burneth unto the lowest Sheol, And devoureth the earth with its increase, And setteth on fire the foundations of the mountains.

units.leftText: I will heap disasters upon them; I will spend My arrows against them.
units.rightText: I will heap evils upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them:

units.leftText: They will be wasted from hunger and ravaged by pestilence and bitter plague; I will send the fangs of wild beasts against them, with the venom of vipers that slither in the dust.
units.rightText: They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat And bitter destruction; And the teeth of beasts will I send upon them, With the poison of crawling things of the dust.

units.leftText: Outside, the sword will take their children, and inside, terror will strike the young man and the young woman, the infant and the gray-haired man.
units.rightText: Without shall the sword bereave, And in the chambers terror; It shall destroy both young man and virgin, The suckling with the man of gray hairs.

units.leftText: I would have said that I would cut them to pieces and blot out their memory from mankind,
units.rightText: I said, I would scatter them afar, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men;

units.leftText: if I had not dreaded the taunt of the enemy, lest their adversaries misunderstand and say: ‘Our own hand has prevailed; it was not the LORD who did all this.’”
units.rightText: Were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, Lest their adversaries should judge amiss, Lest they should say, Our hand is exalted, And Jehovah hath not done all this.

units.leftText: Israel is a nation devoid of counsel, with no understanding among them.
units.rightText: For they are a nation void of counsel, And there is no understanding in them.

units.leftText: If only they were wise, they would understand it; they would comprehend their fate.
units.rightText: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, That they would consider their latter end!

units.leftText: How could one man pursue a thousand, or two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, unless the LORD had given them up?
units.rightText: How should one chase a thousand, And two put ten thousand to flight, Except their Rock had sold them, And Jehovah had delivered them up?

units.leftText: For their rock is not like our Rock, even our enemies concede.
units.rightText: For their rock is not as our Rock, Even our enemies themselves being judges.
leftNotes: 32:31 Hebrew; LXX but our enemies are void of understanding

units.leftText: But their vine is from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poisonous; their clusters are bitter.
units.rightText: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, And of the fields of Gomorrah: Their grapes are grapes of gall, Their clusters are bitter:

units.leftText: Their wine is the venom of serpents, the deadly poison of cobras.
units.rightText: Their wine is the poison of serpents, And the cruel venom of asps.

units.leftText: “Have I not stored up these things, sealed up within My vaults?
units.rightText: Is not this laid up in store with me, Sealed up among my treasures?

units.leftText: Vengeance is Mine; I will repay. In due time their foot will slip; for their day of disaster is near, and their doom is coming quickly.”
units.rightText: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, At the time when their foot shall slide: For the day of their calamity is at hand, And the things that are to come upon them shall make haste.
leftNotes: 32:35 LXX; Hebrew Vengeance is Mine, and recompense; cited in Romans 12:19|ROM 12:19* and Hebrews 10:30

units.leftText: For the LORD will vindicate His people and have compassion on His servants when He sees that their strength is gone and no one remains, slave or free.
units.rightText: For Jehovah will judge his people, And repent himself for his servants; When he seeth that their power is gone, And there is none remaining, shut up or left at large.
leftNotes: 32:36 Or will judge His people; see also LXX; cited in Hebrews 10:30|HEB 10:30*

units.leftText: He will say: “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,
units.rightText: And he will say, Where are their gods, The rock in which they took refuge;

units.leftText: which ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up and help you; let them give you shelter!
units.rightText: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, And drank the wine of their drink-offering? Let them rise up and help you, Let them be your protection.

units.leftText: See now that I am He; there is no God besides Me. I bring death and I give life; I wound and I heal, and there is no one who can deliver from My hand.
units.rightText: See now that I, even I, am he, And there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal; And there is none that can deliver out of my hand.

units.leftText: For I lift up My hand to heaven and declare: As surely as I live forever,
units.rightText: For I lift up my hand to heaven, And say, As I live for ever,

units.leftText: when I sharpen My flashing sword, and My hand grasps it in judgment, I will take vengeance on My adversaries and repay those who hate Me.
units.rightText: If I whet my glittering sword, And my hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine adversaries, And will recompense them that hate me.

units.leftText: I will make My arrows drunk with blood, while My sword devours flesh— the blood of the slain and captives, the heads of the enemy leaders.”
units.rightText: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, And my sword shall devour flesh; With the blood of the slain and the captives, From the head of the leaders of the enemy.

units.leftText: Rejoice, O heavens, with Him, and let all God’s angels worship Him. Rejoice, O nations, with His people; for He will avenge the blood of His children. He will take vengeance on His adversaries and repay those who hate Him; He will cleanse His land and His people.
units.rightText: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: For he will avenge the blood of his servants, And will render vengeance to his adversaries, And will make expiation for his land, for his people.
leftNotes: 32:43 See DSS and LXX; MT lacks Rejoice, O heavens, with Him, and let all God’s angels worship Him.Cited in Hebrews 1:6|HEB 1:6*
32:43 Cited in Romans 15:10|ROM 15:10*
32:43 DSS and LXX; MT servants
32:43 LXX and Vulgate; MT lacks and repay those who hate Him

units.leftText: Then Moses came with Joshua son of Nun and recited all the words of this song in the hearing of the people.
units.rightText: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.
leftNotes: 32:44 LXX, Syriac, and Vulgate; Hebrew Hoshea, a variant of Joshua

units.leftText: When Moses had finished reciting all these words to all Israel,
units.rightText: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel;

units.leftText: he said to them, “Take to heart all the words I have solemnly declared to you this day, so that you may command your children to carefully follow all the words of this law.
units.rightText: and he said unto them, Set your heart unto all the words which I testify unto you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, even all the words of this law.

units.leftText: For they are not idle words to you, because they are your life, and by them you will live long in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.” Moses’ Death Foretold
units.rightText: For it is no vain thing for you; because it is your life, and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over the Jordan to possess it.

units.leftText: On that same day the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,

units.leftText: “Go up into the Abarim Range to Mount Nebo, in the land of Moab across from Jericho, and view the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites as their own possession.
units.rightText: Get thee up into this mountain of Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession;

units.leftText: And there on the mountain that you climb, you will die and be gathered to your people, just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people.
units.rightText: and die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:

units.leftText: For at the waters of Meribah-kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin, both of you broke faith with Me among the Israelites by failing to treat Me as holy in their presence.
units.rightText: because ye trespassed against me in the midst of the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.

units.leftText: Although you shall see from a distance the land that I am giving the Israelites, you shall not enter it.”
units.rightText: For thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither into the land which I give the children of Israel.

units.leftText: This is the blessing that Moses the man of God pronounced upon the Israelites before his death.
units.rightText: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

units.leftText: He said: “The LORD came from Sinai and dawned upon us from Seir; He shone forth from Mount Paran and came with myriads of holy ones, with flaming fire at His right hand.
units.rightText: And he said, Jehovah came from Sinai, And rose from Seir unto them; He shined forth from mount Paran, And he came from the ten thousands of holy ones: At his right hand was a fiery law for them.
leftNotes: 33:2 LXX, Syriac, and Vulgate; Hebrew upon them
33:2 Or with myriads of holy ones from the south, from His mountain slopes

units.leftText: Surely You love the people; all the holy ones are in Your hand, and they sit down at Your feet; each receives Your words —
units.rightText: Yea, he loveth the people; All his saints are in thy hand: And they sat down at thy feet; Every one shall receive of thy words.
leftNotes: 33:3 Or they follow in Your steps

units.leftText: the law that Moses gave us, the possession of the assembly of Jacob.
units.rightText: Moses commanded us a law, An inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.

units.leftText: So the LORD became King in Jeshurun when the leaders of the people gathered, when the tribes of Israel came together.
units.rightText: And he was king in Jeshurun, When the heads of the people were gathered, All the tribes of Israel together.
leftNotes: 33:5 Jeshurun means the upright one, a term of endearment for Israel; also in verse 26.

units.leftText: Let Reuben live and not die, nor his men be few.”
units.rightText: Let Reuben live, and not die; Nor let his men be few.
leftNotes: 33:6 Or but let

units.leftText: And concerning Judah he said: “O LORD, hear the cry of Judah and bring him to his people. With his own hands he defends his cause, but may You be a help against his foes.”
units.rightText: And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Jehovah, the voice of Judah, And bring him in unto his people. With his hands he contended for himself; And thou shalt be a help against his adversaries.

units.leftText: Concerning Levi he said: “Give Your Thummim to Levi and Your Urim to Your godly one, whom You tested at Massah and contested at the waters of Meribah.
units.rightText: And of Levi he said, Thy Thummim and thy Urim are with thy godly one, Whom thou didst prove at Massah, With whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;
leftNotes: 33:8 DSS and LXX; MT does not include to Levi; literally Let Your Perfections and Your Lights be to Your godly one.
33:8 Massah means testing; see Exodus 17:7|EXO 17:7*.
33:8 Meribah means quarreling; see Exodus 17:7|EXO 17:7*.

units.leftText: He said of his father and mother, ‘I do not consider them.’ He disregarded his brothers and did not know his own sons, for he kept Your word and maintained Your covenant.
units.rightText: Who said of his father, and of his mother, I have not seen him; Neither did he acknowledge his brethren, Nor knew he his own children: For they have observed thy word, And keep thy covenant.
leftNotes: 33:9 Hebrew they kept, most likely referring to Levi in the plural; similarly twice in verse 10

units.leftText: He will teach Your ordinances to Jacob and Your law to Israel; he will set incense before You and whole burnt offerings on Your altar.
units.rightText: They shall teach Jacob thine ordinances, And Israel thy law: They shall put incense before thee, And whole burnt-offering upon thine altar.

units.leftText: Bless his substance, O LORD, and accept the work of his hands. Smash the loins of those who rise against him, and of his foes so they can rise no more.”
units.rightText: Bless, Jehovah, his substance, And accept the work of his hands: Smite through the loins of them that rise up against him, And of them that hate him, that they rise not again.

units.leftText: Concerning Benjamin he said: “May the beloved of the LORD rest secure in Him; God shields him all day long, and upon His shoulders he rests.”
units.rightText: Of Benjamin he said, The beloved of Jehovah shall dwell in safety by him; He covereth him all the day long, And he dwelleth between his shoulders.
leftNotes: 33:12 LXX; Hebrew He shields

units.leftText: Concerning Joseph he said: “May his land be blessed by the LORD with the precious dew from heaven above and the deep waters that lie beneath,
units.rightText: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of Jehovah be his land, For the precious things of heaven, for the dew, And for the deep that coucheth beneath,

units.leftText: with the bountiful harvest from the sun and the abundant yield of the seasons,
units.rightText: And for the precious things of the fruits of the sun, And for the precious things of the growth of the moons,

units.leftText: with the best of the ancient mountains and the bounty of the everlasting hills,
units.rightText: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, And for the precious things of the everlasting hills,

units.leftText: with the choice gifts of the land and everything in it, and with the favor of Him who dwelt in the burning bush. May these rest on the head of Joseph and crown the brow of the prince of his brothers.
units.rightText: And for the precious things of the earth and the fulness thereof, And the good will of him that dwelt in the bush. Let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, And upon the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.

units.leftText: His majesty is like a firstborn bull, and his horns are like those of a wild ox. With them he will gore the nations, even to the ends of the earth. Such are the myriads of Ephraim, and such are the thousands of Manasseh.”
units.rightText: The firstling of his herd, majesty is his; And his horns are the horns of the wild-ox: With them he shall push the peoples all of them, even the ends of the earth: And they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, And they are the thousands of Manasseh.

units.leftText: Concerning Zebulun he said: “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your journeys, and Issachar, in your tents.
units.rightText: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; And, Issachar, in thy tents.

units.leftText: They will call the peoples to a mountain; there they will offer sacrifices of righteousness. For they will feast on the abundance of the seas and the hidden treasures of the sand.”
units.rightText: They shall call the peoples unto the mountain; There shall they offer sacrifices of righteousness: For they shall suck the abundance of the seas, And the hidden treasures of the sand.

units.leftText: Concerning Gad he said: “Blessed is he who enlarges the domain of Gad! He lies down like a lion and tears off an arm or a head.
units.rightText: And of Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad: He dwelleth as a lioness, And teareth the arm, yea, the crown of the head.

units.leftText: He chose the best land for himself, because a ruler’s portion was reserved for him there. He came with the leaders of the people; he administered the LORD’s justice and His ordinances for Israel.”
units.rightText: And he provided the first part for himself, For there was the lawgiver’s portion reserved; And he came with the heads of the people; He executed the righteousness of Jehovah, And his ordinances with Israel.

units.leftText: Concerning Dan he said: “Dan is a lion’s cub, leaping out of Bashan.”
units.rightText: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion’s whelp, That leapeth forth from Bashan.

units.leftText: Concerning Naphtali he said: “Naphtali is abounding with favor, full of the blessing of the LORD; he shall take possession of the sea and the south.”
units.rightText: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favor, And full with the blessing of Jehovah, Possess thou the west and the south.
leftNotes: 33:23 Or the west

units.leftText: And concerning Asher he said: “May Asher be the most blessed of sons; may he be the most favored among his brothers and dip his foot in oil.
units.rightText: And of Asher he said, Blessed be Asher with children; Let him be acceptable unto his brethren, And let him dip his foot in oil.

units.leftText: May the bolts of your gate be iron and bronze, and may your strength match your days.”
units.rightText: Thy bars shall be iron and brass; And as thy days, so shall thy strength be.

units.leftText: “There is none like the God of Jeshurun, who rides the heavens to your aid, and the clouds in His majesty.
units.rightText: There is none like unto God, O Jeshurun, Who rideth upon the heavens for thy help, And in his excellency on the skies.

units.leftText: The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He drives out the enemy before you, giving the command, ‘Destroy him!’
units.rightText: The eternal God is thy dwelling-place, And underneath are the everlasting arms. And he thrust out the enemy from before thee, And said, Destroy.

units.leftText: So Israel dwells securely; the fountain of Jacob lives untroubled in a land of grain and new wine, where even the heavens drip with dew.
units.rightText: And Israel dwelleth in safety, The fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine; Yea, his heavens drop down dew.
